name: fleet-swarm-missiles
notes: M2 step 4 gate (A): a missile/swarm/artillery fleet doctrine. Compare with fleet-capital-beams and fleet-neutral (same fixture). Single runs 2026-10-12: Swarm built 57% small, missiles 47% of weapons, design missile mounts 51->130; Capital built 25% small, beams 38%, design beams 123->168 and kinetics 67->22; neutral 44% small, missiles/beams 31% each. Hull bias tuning (2026-10-13), small-hull share of ships built: neutral 0.44/0.36; Swarm at HullSizeBias 2: 0.57/0.44/0.43; at 3: 0.59/0.51 -> default 3, assert >= 0.47 (above neutral's best).
